svg.title: Combining this universal nonadaptive bound with the separately certified four-copy adaptive error < 0.103471 proves strict feedback benefit in the principal noisy parent over all continuous nonadaptive equatorial schedules. This is stronger than comparing selected angle allocations. The certificate is not an exact nonadaptive optimum; numerical exploration near 0.10476238 remains separately labelled. For the selected tolerance 519/5000 = 0.1038, the exact copy minima are four adaptive versus five randomized nonadaptive. The three-copy adaptive equality gives a lower risk ≃0.13587961, the four-copy adaptive construction passes, and the universal four-copy nonadaptive lower bound fails the target.
